related.title: Bash：引號、參數邊界與安全管線
related.titleEn: Bash: quoting, argument boundaries and reliable pipelines
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付程序樹、錯誤路徑測試與 wait 紀錄；不得把 exec 次數計為新增程序數。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver the process tree, failure-path tests and wait records; never count exec calls as newly created processes. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 用只印出參數序號與 repr 的程式接收陣列；比較 "$@"、單一拼接字串及空參數。
related.differenceEn: Pass an array to a program that prints argument index and repr; compare "$@", one concatenated string and an empty argument.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
fork 建立子行程；exec 成功時替換目前行程映像而不另創 PID。只把成功 exec 後的程式碼視為不可達。
本課數值核對：1+3 = 4 processes；另一項核對：4+0 = 4 processes。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

引號控制展開與字詞分割；資料中有空格不應變成多個參數。管線整體狀態與各子命令狀態必須分開解釋。
本課數值核對：1+2+1 = 4 arguments；另一項核對：1+1+1 = 3 arguments。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
fork creates a child; successful exec replaces the current process image without allocating another PID. Code after successful exec is unreachable.
Numeric audit: 1+3 = 4 processes; second audit: 4+0 = 4 processes. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Quoting controls expansion and word splitting; spaces inside data should not create extra arguments. Interpret pipeline status separately from each command’s status.
Numeric audit: 1+2+1 = 4 arguments; second audit: 1+1+1 = 3 arguments. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Linux cgroup v2：CPU 配額與節流
related.titleEn: Linux cgroup v2: CPU quotas and throttling
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付程序樹、錯誤路徑測試與 wait 紀錄；不得把 exec 次數計為新增程序數。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver the process tree, failure-path tests and wait records; never count exec calls as newly created processes. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 建立wall-time與CPU-time兩軸，逐1 ms累計兩worker消耗；列period重置點。
related.differenceEn: Track wall time separately from CPU time, accumulating two workers’ consumption per millisecond and marking period resets.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
fork 建立子行程；exec 成功時替換目前行程映像而不另創 PID。只把成功 exec 後的程式碼視為不可達。
本課數值核對：1+3 = 4 processes；另一項核對：4+0 = 4 processes。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

CPU配額限制每period可使用的累計CPU時間；多核心平行工作可更早耗盡配額。節流不是每個任務各得同一配額。
本課數值核對：50/100 = 0.5 CPU_equivalent；另一項核對：50/2 = 25 ms。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
fork creates a child; successful exec replaces the current process image without allocating another PID. Code after successful exec is unreachable.
Numeric audit: 1+3 = 4 processes; second audit: 4+0 = 4 processes. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

A CPU quota limits accumulated CPU time per period; parallel workers can exhaust it earlier. It is not a separate quota for every task.
Numeric audit: 50/100 = 0.5 CPU_equivalent; second audit: 50/2 = 25 ms. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
